analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance is maintained for the third consecutive trading session. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement. ADX at 26.1 suggests a trend is forming, but weekly RSI at 44.2 and weekly ADX at 17.9 indicate a lack of long-term trend. The current price ($0.08) aligns with SMA5, SMA20, EMA10, EMA20, and EMA50, while trading below SMA50 ($0.09) and EMA200 ($0.09). The 52-week position at 8.6% remains near the lower end.
